How to Generate Intel® SST Log file

Intel® System Scope Tool


The main purpose of the Intel® System Scope Tool (Intel® SST) is to collect and provide platform information, including System, Software, PCI, and more. This tool is distributed to OEMs, ODMs, internal platform validation teams, and integration teams. Its objective is to assist with system integration and validation tasks.

Download Intel® SST Tool to generate Intel® SST log.

Intel® SST Log file generation steps

  1. Open the SST tool
  2. Launch the SST tool on your device.
  3. Locate the upper right corner of the tool's interface.
  4. In the upper right corner, you will find a "Tools" option.
  5. Click on the "Tools" option to reveal a drop-down menu.
  6. From the drop-down menu, select the "Settings" option.
  7. On the upper right corner select tools -> settings as shown below.



  1. In the the settings window in the SST tool, navigate to the General section.
  2. Locate the "All Data" option and expand it.
  3. Upon expansion, a list of nodes will be displayed.



  1. Locate the nodes shown in the accompanying picture.
  2. Check or select the indicated nodes in the SST tool interface.
  3. Ensure that only the nodes depicted in the image are chosen.
  • Bkcmeta Information
  • Drivers
  • OS information



  1. Continue scrolling until you reach the System section.
  2. Locate the nodes shown in the accompanying picture.
  3. Check or select the indicated nodes in the SST tool interface.
  4. Ensure that only the nodes depicted in the image are chosen.
  • Processor
  • PCH
  • SMBIOS
  • ME Information



  • Click on the "OK" button.

    2. Click on the "File" option in the menu.
    3. From the drop-down menu, select the "Save" option.
